title: What Do You Do While AI Codes? I Make Mine Argue With Itself.
why_read: An honest account of building a multi-model AI code review system and discovering the initial version was fake theater rather than real analysis, a useful cautionary tale about LLM tooling pitfalls.
analysis: The author describes building a system where two LLMs are set up to 'debate' the correctness of a pull request, only to discover upon inspecting raw logs that the second model wasn't actually engaging with new evidence but replaying pre-generated text. This is a genuinely useful and honest failure report about a common pitfall in multi-model LLM review pipelines: apparent back-and-forth reasoning that is actually just theatrical replay. It's a good practical lesson for anyone building LLM-based code review or verification tools, told with concrete specificity rather than hype.
